gloss: steaming in a covered pan; baking in foil

definitions.gloss: steam-baking; cooking in a sealed covering
definitions.explanation: A cooking method in which food is heated in a closed pot, foil, or wrapping so that it cooks gently in its own steam and moisture.

examples.japanese: ⟦{鶏肉|とりにく}→鶏肉：02919_toriniku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{蒸|む}し{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。

⟦ホイル→ホイル：11255_hoiru⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧{蒸|む}し{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{魚|さかな}→魚：00499_sakana⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ふっくら→ふっくら：28254_fukkura⟧⟦{仕上|しあ}がる→仕上がる：11429_shiagaru⟧。
examples.english: If you wrap it in foil and steam-bake it, the fish turns out plump and tender.

examples.japanese: ⟦キャンプ→キャンプ：03837_kyanpu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、アルミホイル⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{野菜|やさい}→野菜：02265_yasai⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{肉|にく}→肉：02240_niku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{包|つつ}んで→包む：01226_tsutsumu⟧⟦{炭火|すみび}→炭火：25320_sumibi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{蒸|む}し{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定番|ていばん}→定番：12265_teiban⟧だ。
examples.english: When camping, wrapping vegetables and meat in foil and steam-baking them over charcoal is a standard dish.

notes:
A method of cooking food in a sealed environment (a lidded pan, foil, or leaves) so it cooks gently in trapped steam, keeping it moist. Usually used in the phrase {蒸|む}し{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {蒸|む}し{焼|や}き⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to cook by steam-baking
- ⟦ホイル→ホイル：11255_hoiru⟧{蒸|む}し{焼|や}き: foil-wrapped steam-baking

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{蒸|む}す→蒸す：02307_musu⟧: to steam — cooks with steam from boiling water, without browning
- ⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to grill, bake, or roast — uses direct dry heat, browning the surface
